rules.description: Claimant must be an employee, not a worker or self-employed
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be an employee to qualify for Statutory Maternity Pay. Workers and self-employed individuals are not eligible.

rules.description: Claimant must earn on average at least £125 per week
rules.reason_if_failed: Your average weekly earnings are below £125. You may be eligible for Maternity Allowance instead.

rules.description: Claimant must have worked continuously for at least 26 weeks by the qualifying week
rules.reason_if_failed: You must have worked continuously for your employer for at least 26 weeks by the 15th week before your due date (the qualifying week).

rules.description: Claimant must provide proof of pregnancy (MATB1 certificate or doctor/midwife letter)
rules.reason_if_failed: You must provide a MATB1 certificate or letter from your doctor/midwife to claim SMP.

rules.description: Claimant must give at least 28 days' notice before the desired SMP start date
rules.reason_if_failed: You must give your employer at least 28 days' notice before you want SMP to start, unless the baby is born early.

rules.description: Claimant must not be in police custody during the maternity pay period
rules.reason_if_failed: You cannot receive SMP while in police custody. SMP will not restart when you are discharged.

explanation_template: Statutory Maternity Pay eligibility: {outcome}. If eligible, you will receive 90% of your average weekly earnings for 6 weeks, then £187.18 or 90% (whichever is lower) for 33 weeks.

edge_cases.description: Baby is born early or stillborn after 24th week of pregnancy
edge_cases.action: Still eligible for SMP and Statutory Maternity Leave. SMP starts automatically the day after birth if early.
Still eligible for full SMP and Statutory Maternity Leave entitlement.
Not eligible for SMP. Direct to Statutory Adoption Leave and Pay instead.

edge_cases.description: Does not meet SMP eligibility criteria
edge_cases.action: Employer must provide form SMP1 within 7 days. Direct claimant to Maternity Allowance service.
